messages:
sre-oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Hosted API queue p99 > 20s and backlog growth detected in us-west1. Autoscaler attempts failing with provisioning errors. Paging @oliver (oncall) and @maria (infra).

oliver: saw the page, joining. what's the current queue size?

maria: quick metrics: queue length ~ 28k requests, enqueue rate ~ 2.2k/s, dequeue rate ~ 600/s. p95 ~ 1.8s, p99 ~ 24s. GPU pool utilization 100% on hosted-dedicated-1.

ken: any quota errors from the cloud? provisioner logs show repeated create failures: "QuotaExceeded: GPU quota" and some 429s from the instance API.

jess: customers are seeing timeouts, some 504s from the edge. Support flagged Org: acme-inc two 10x error spikes.

oliver: ok, plan: 1) enable fallback routing to lower-tier model-variants to reduce per-request GPU usage 2) pause non-critical background jobs hitting hosted pools 3) attempt quota bump with cloud (but that'll take time).

maria: fallback routing is stuck — config apply to route:routing-policy failed with "provisioner: allocation stalled". Looks like the provisioner can't allocate new thin pools because of quota+instance-group limits.

ops-bot: runbook check: recommended action is to scale dedicated pool from 40 -> 64 nodes, or enable cross-region spillover to us-east1. Cross-region requires config toggle (can cause 300ms extra latency).

ken: cross-region toggle looks safe. I'm going to flip spillover to us-east1 for the next 30m. Will monitor tail latencies.

oliver: go ahead ken. also start a canary of fallback model routing to 2% traffic. use flag: \`--fallback=variant-lowmem --pct=2\`.

maria: cloud ticket filed (TKT-54211) requesting temporary GPU quota increase; support said maybe 45-90 min. Provisioner logs still showing node create failures: "preemptiblePool exhausted".

jess: note: we should notify affected customers with ETA. I can push a short status update: "experiencing elevated latency and timeouts in us-west1, mitigation in progress; potential degraded performance for a subset of requests."

oliver: thanks. ken, did spillover apply cleanly?

ken: applied. confirmation from autoscaler: "spillover-policy: active -> us-east1". initial effect: dequeue rate up to 1.1k/s, queue down to 18k. p99 dropped to 16s. still above SLO.

alan: I see some model-variant nodes in us-east1 also nearly saturated. If queue continues to drop slowly we should be fine, otherwise we need emergency rate-limit.

oliver: let's hold off rate-limit for now — try to buy time. Maria, can you pause non-critical background jobs? Which services?

maria: pausing batch embedding workers (batch-emb-prod) and model rewarm tasks. Commands run: ```rictl service pause batch-emb-prod --cluster hosted-us-west1
rictl task cancel rewarm-* --cluster hosted-us-west1```

ops-bot: action log updated: paused batch-emb-prod, cancelled rewarm tasks. Estimated freed capacity ~ 10%.

oliver: good. monitor impact for 5m. If p99 doesn't move under 10s within 10m we will enable emergency request shedding for best-effort customers. Jess, draft customer note but hold send until we decide.

jess: drafting now. will include PS: teams can switch to lower-concurrency clients to avoid retries.

ken: after spillover + job pause, queue 12m later: queue 9.5k, dequeue 1.5k/s, p99 8.7s. trending down.

maria: provisioning still showing intermittent quota 429s when attempting to create new thin-pool nodes; autoscaler is retrying.

oliver: okay — looks like immediate mitigations working. keep the incident open, SRE oncall stays. ken, keep spillover active for 30m past recovery. Maria, follow up on quota ticket and prepare fallback to manual node injection if cloud can't increase quota in time.

jess: prepared status update: "We experienced a traffic surge causing GPU capacity exhaustion and autoscaler provisioning failures in us-west1. Spillover to us-east1 and pausing noncritical jobs reduced backlog; p99 latencies improving. We're coordinating with cloud to increase quota and will provide updates." Will post in #status-pages in 10m.

oliver: handoff note for next oncall: watch for rebound, check queue + cloud quota errors, and coordinate with cloud on TKT-54211. If queue grows >15k again, enable emergency rate-limit for public keys flagged as heavy.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident state -> monitoring. Owner: oliver. Severity: Sev2. Next check-in in 15m.

oliver: thanks all. leaving the channel (handing to maria) — maria, you are the lead for the next hour.

maria: on it, taking over. will update every 10m or on major change.
